description: Currently-active products selected in a specific campaign for a marketplace: one row per selected product with merchant_id, product_id, product_name, availability (e.g. 'in stock'), brand, and category L1/L2/L3. Point-in-time (no date range). campaign_id is a mandatory filter and resolves to campaign_tagging_data.marketing_campaign_id. Only active selections (opaps.is_active = TRUE) on non-deleted product dimensions (ompd.is_deleted = FALSE) are returned; filter availability = 'in stock' to restrict to in-stock products. Source tables are per-marketplace suffixed (os_product_ads_product_selection_<mcid>, oltp_merchandise_product_dimensions_<mcid>). Python layer derives product list, category_l1 breakdown, category hierarchy, and summary counts (total/in-stock products, unique brands and categories).

campaign_id.description: The marketing_campaign_id the caller holds. Mandatory filter: pass the campaign's marketing_campaign_id here; campaign_tagging_data resolves it to the internal campaign whose active product selection is returned.

merchant_id.description: Merchant (seller) that owns the selected product.

product_id.description: Product / SKU id selected in the campaign (joins to the product-dimension sku_id).

product_name.description: Display name of the product (product-dimension e_name).

availability.description: Stock availability of the product (e.g. 'in stock', 'out of stock'). Filter availability = 'in stock' to restrict to in-stock products.

category_l2.description: Level-2 product category (may be null when only L1 is present).

category_l3.description: Level-3 (leaf) product category (may be null when only L1/L2 are present).

placeholder_metric.description: Constant 0. Row-level product-selection passthrough with no aggregated measure; KAM requires at least one metric to fetch.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_product_ads_product_selection___SP_MARKETPLACE_CLIENT_ID__` AS opaps INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.campaign_tagging_data` AS ctd ON SAFE_CAST(opaps.campaign_id AS STRING) = SAFE_CAST(ctd.campaign_id AS STRING) AND SAFE_CAST(opaps.account_id AS STRING) = SAFE_CAST(ctd.account_id AS STRING) INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.oltp_merchandise_product_dimensions___SP_MARKETPLACE_CLIENT_ID__` AS ompd ON SAFE_CAST(opaps.product_id AS STRING) = SAFE_CAST(ompd.sku_id AS STRING) AND SAFE_CAST(opaps.merchant_id AS STRING) = SAFE_CAST(ompd.merchant_id AS STRING) AND SAFE_CAST(opaps.client_id AS STRING) = SAFE_CAST(ompd.client_id AS STRING) WHERE ompd.is_deleted = FALSE AND opaps.is_active = TRUE AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
